highlights.title: DeepSeek is China’s latest developer to worry about losing control of AI
highlights.description: Chinese artificial intelligence start-up DeepSeek has commissioned a third-party evaluation to assess whether its flagship model, V4 Pro, could escape human control, making it the latest Chinese AI developer to signal its concerns with the growing risks surrounding the technology. The evaluation, published on Wednesday by Beijing-based AI safety consultancy Concordia AI, concluded that the model showed “limited ability” to replicate itself or deceive its human creators, though it resisted...

highlights.title: Norway’s Wealth Fund Again Votes No to Musk’s Tesla Pay Package
highlights.description: Norway’s $2.2 trillion sovereign wealth fund said it is voting against Elon Musk’s 2025 pay package at Tesla Inc.’s annual meeting next week.
